description: Full-text search across all EDGAR filings for a keyword or phrase (e.g. a risk factor, product name, or executive). Returns matching filings with company, form type, and date. Optionally restrict to a form type.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

query.description: Words or an exact phrase to find anywhere in EDGAR filing text, e.g. "going concern" or a product name.

name: filing_search

provenance.description: Where this answer came from. served_at is when Datakoot answered (UTC); upstream lists the official sources consulted. Datakoot may serve a briefly cached copy, so the source's own observation can be older than served_at.

title: Filing Search
